item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q002_mazg_hise_remote_homology","answer":"In the current public SCOPe base release 2.08, d1vmga_ (1vmg chain A) is classified in the MazG-like family, a.204.1.2 (sunid 116993), whereas d1y6xa1 (1y6x chain A, residues 7–93) is in the HisE-like (PRA-PH) family, a.204.1.4 (sunid 140797). Both families belong to the same all-alpha NTP pyrophosphatases superfamily, a.204.1 (sunid 101386), and consequently the same a.204 fold and all-alpha class. The shared superfamily supports remote homology—probable common ancestry despite divergence too great for placement in one family—rather than merely a similar fold. Their separation into distinct families means SCOPe does not support close, family-level equivalence. SCOPe annotates d1y6xa1 under phosphoribosyl-ATP pyrophosphatase HisE, but the d1vmga_ protein node is only a hypothetical Sulfolobus solfataricus protein in the MazG-like family. Therefore it would go beyond this classification to assert that d1vmga_ is HisE, that either domain has the other's exact substrate specificity or physiological role, or that their catalytic residues, metal dependence, kinetics, and reaction chemistry are interchangeable. Even the superfamily name is not biochemical verification for either individual domain. Those claims require independent sequence/profile and conserved-active-site evidence, ligand-bound structural evidence, genomic context, and preferably direct biochemical assays. Cross-family use as a structural template is reasonable only at the overall fold/domain level; family-specific loops and active sites should not be transferred without validation, and these two domains should not be treated as interchangeable functional representatives. A same-family representative should be preferred for detailed modeling or function transfer when available.","evidence_used":["/api/v1/","/api/v1/releases/2.08/resolve/d1vmga_","/api/v1/releases/2.08/resolve/d1y6xa1","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/113676","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/122676","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/116995","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/140801","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/116994","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/140798","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/116993","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/140797","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/101386","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/101385","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/46456"]}]}
